heading.title: About
heading.subtitle: A quick intro about who I am and what I do.

paragraphs: I'm SATANAND, a Results-driven Data Analyst and MIS Executive with 4+ years of experience transforming manual processes into automated, data-driven systems, using Excel VBA, Google Apps Script, Power BI, and Google AppSheet.

I specialize in architecting and deploying production-grade systems for resource-constrained MSME manufacturing environments using no-code/low-code platforms and AI-assisted development. Proven track record of reducing reporting time by 40%, eliminating manual errors, and enabling executive-level decision-making. Currently retained as technical consultant by two former employers.
